hymns.title: Bwenzi lina longa Yesu
verses:
1. Bwenzi lina longa Yesu, palibe
Angathe wina kutichiritsa? Iyayi

2. Pena womfuna adakanidwa? Palibe
Adzatikaniza malo m'mwamba? Iyayi

3. Alipo mpulumutsi wina? Palibe
Woti angatithandize ife? Iyayi
hymns.chorus:
Yesu adziwa zathu zonse,
Iye adzanditsogoza.
Bwenzi lina longa Yesu, palibe

hymns.title: Chikondi ndichotu
verses:
1. Chikondi ndichotu,
Chiyanjanitsafe;
Pakukondana ifeyo
Titsanza m'mwambamo

2. Pamaso pakepo
Tigwade tonsefe
Chiyembekezo chathucho
Nchimodzimodzidi

3. Tithandizanedi
M'mavuto athuwo
Timasangalatsanatu
M'nsoni zomwenso

4. Tikalekanafe
Timamva chisoni
Tikhulupira kutitu
Tidzaonananso

hymns.title: Ndinamira m'machimo
verses:
1. Ndinamira m'machimo, wosaonekanso
Ndinamira ndithudi, wosaturukanso;
Koma Yesu adamva, kulira kwangako
Nandipulumutsa ku machimo

2. Mtima wanga ndipatsa, ndidzamkangamira
Ndidzakhala mwa iye; ndikumyimbirabe
Mtima wanga uyimba, za chikondi chake
Tsono ndidzatumikira Yesuyo

3. Obvutika penyani, Yesu olanditsa
Adzakutulutsani m'mafunde oopysa
Ndiye mwini nyanjayo, mafunde amvera
Akhozadi kukupulumutsani
hymns.chorus:
Nandikweza (kweza)
Nandikweza (kweza)
Pomira m'thopemo
Andikweza.
Nandikweza, nandikweza
Pomira m'thopemo
Andikweza

hymns.title: Mbuye sindisamala
verses:
1. Mbuye sindisamala kukhala wachuma
Ndifuna kukalowa mdziko lakumwamba
M'buku lokometsetsa la ufumu wanu
Kodi lalembedwamo, Mbuye dzina langa?

3. Kumzinda wokoma wa malo owalawo
Ndi anthu obvala za ulemelero
Kumene choipa sichidzawonekerako,
Kodi dzina langa liripo m'Bukumo?
hymns.chorus:
Kodi dzina langa lalembedwa m'mwamba?
M'buku la ufumuwo kodi lalembedwa?

hymns.title: Anthu aku m'mawawo
verses:
2. Adafulumiratu, mwachimwemwe, kuli 'Ye
Mfumu ya mafumudi namgwadira mwanayo
Momwemo, mokondwera ife timulambira

3. Napereka anthuwo mphatso za mtengo wake
Kwa mwanayo Yesuyo-lubani, mule, golidi:
Choncho tipereke'fe zonse zathu kwa iye

5. M'dziko la kuyeralo dzuwa, mwezi kulibe
Kuunika kwakeko ndiye Yesu Yekhadi
Timukhumba yemweyo kuntamanda Mfumuyo

hymns.title: Ndikhulupilira Yesu
verses:
1. Ndikhulupilira Yesu
Ndiye mpulumutsiyo;
Ndipumule mwa lonjezo
Ndi umlemekeza 'Ye

2. Ndikhulupilira Yesu
Ndi mwazi wakewo,
Kuti anditsuke ine
Mpaka ndiyeretu mbuu!

3. Ndikhulupilira Yesu
Kuti ndisachimweyi
Kuti ndilandire moyo
Ndi chimwemwe chakecho

4. Ndikondwera pakumdziwa
Mpulumutsi wangayo;
Akhala nane mpaka
Kuchimaliziroko.
hymns.chorus:
Ndikhulupilira Yesu
Ndiye mpulumutsiyo
Yesu ndiye wachifundo
Ndikhulupilira 'Ye

hymns.title: Sangalatsa akusowa
verses:
1. Sangalatsa akusowa, masiku alikutha
Pali anthu otayika, masiku alikutha
Ngati tikondwerera pakuyenda ulendowu
Tonse tidzachita bwino, masiku alikutha

2. Tisakhale aulesi, masiku alikutha
Nkhope zathu zikondwere, masiku alikutha
Dziko ili ndilochimwa, lodzala ndi chisoni
Thangatani akugwa, masiku alikutha

3. Tamangidwa ndi unyolo, masiku alikutha
Tisiyetu zoipa, masiku alikutha
Tonsefe zabwinotu tidzakhala ndi Mulungu
Ndipo tidzakondwera ku nthawi za muyaya
hymns.chorus:
Akutha, akutha, masiku akutha
Tonse tichite bwino, masiku alikutha

hymns.title: Ndifuna kuyimbiradi
verses:
1. Ndifuna kuyimbiradi
Zolemekeza Yesu
Pakuti andikondadi
Nditumikira Yesu.

2. Pakumuona Ambuye
Wokhomedwa pamtanda
Aliwombole dzikoli,
Ndilape ndi chisoni

3. Pakuyesedwa mtimamu
Ndipempherera Yesu
Amandilimbikitsapo
Ndilemekeze Yesu

4. Uthenga wanu, Mbuyathu
Ndifuna kubukitsa
Kuti ochima enanso
Ayambe kuyimbira
hymns.chorus:
Ndimtame, mtame, mtame, Yesuyo
Mtame, mtame, masiku onsewo

hymns.title: Ndinasochera mtalimo
verses:
1. Ndinasochera mtalimo,
Mbuye ndidzako
Ndilapa tchimo langali
Mbuye ndidzako

2. Ndamwaza zaka zambiri,
Mbuye ndidzako;
Uwawa mtima wangawu,
Mbuye ndidzako.

3. Ndatopa ndi zoipazi,
Mbuye ndidzako;
Ndimvera mau anuwo,
Mbuye ndidzako.

4. Anandifera Yesuyo,
Mbuye ndidzako;
Ndiyembekeza Iyeyo
Mbuye ndidzako.

5. Ndisowa mwazi wanuwo,
Mbuye ndidzako;
Nditsukeni ndiyere mbuu!
Mbuye ndidzako.
hymns.chorus:
Ndidzako, ndidzako, ndiri kudzako
Mwa chifundo chanucho Mbuye ndidzako

hymns.title: Ndilibetu manyazi'ne
verses:
1. Ndilibetu manyazi'ne
Kubvomera Mbuye
Yemwe anandifera 'ne
Imfa ya pamtanda

2. Yesu ndiye Mbuye wanga
Ndidziwa inetu;
Iye sadzandikana 'ne
Pa tsiku lijalo

3. Ndakopekatu m'timamu
Ndi Mbuyanga Yesu
Kuti ali wamphamvutu
Wakundisunga'ne

4. Yerusalemu woyera
Wotsika kumwamba
Mzinda wa Mulungu wanga
Momwe ndidzakhala.
hymns.chorus:
Pamtanda, pamtanda
Ndidaona kuwala
Ndipo mdima wangawo usachoka
Tsopanoli ndionatu mbee!
Ndiri kukondwa nthawi zonse

hymns.title: Ndiimba ndi chimwemwe lero
hymns.chorus:
O Aleluya-a-a! O Aleluya-a-a!
Walowa Yesu mumtima mwanga, O Aleluya

hymns.title: Kulitu dziko lakuwala
verses:
1. Kulitu dziko lakuwala ndithu
Kunthawi zosatha
Komwe kulibe mdima bii!
Chimwemwe chosathanso

2. Kulitu dziko lamtenderedi
Kokhala Yesuyo
Komwe kulibe mdima bii!
Chimwemwe chosathanso
hymns.chorus:
Mtandawo tikasenza
Korona tidzavala
Pamodzi ndi woyera
M'dziko la kumwambako

hymns.title: Mulungu wafafaniza zoipa zangawo
verses:
1. Mulungu wafafaniza zoipa zangazo;
Werengani malemba m'buku la Yesaya
Mutu 44 ndime 22
Wafafaniza zoipa zanga, waterotu

2. Yesu ali kubwera kutenga akewo;
Timawerenga choncho m'buku la Yohane
Mutu ndi 14, ndime 1,2,3
Adzanditenga ndikumulandira tsopanoli

3. Mzimu Woyera'Inu mphanvu yathu ndinu
Tione zozizwa zanu m'buku la Machitidwe
Tiwerengamo Mutu 1,2,3
Monga kalelo, ntchito yanuyo mugwirebe

hymns.title: Mulungu adapatsa moyo
verses:
1. Mulungu adapatsa moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Mulungu adapatsa moyo
Adapatsa moyo wosatha

2. Anthu adakana moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Anthu adakana moyo
Adakana moyo wosatha

3. Yesu apatsanso moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Yesu apatsanso moyo
Apatsanso moyo wosatha

4. Kodi mwalandira moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha?
Kodi mwalandira moyo
Mwalandira moyo wosatha

5. Ine ndalandira moyo
Moyo, moyo wosatha
Ine ndalandira moyo wosatha
Ndalandira moyo wosatha?

6. Moyo uwoneke moyo, moyo
Moyo, wosatha
Moyo uwoneke moyo, moyo
Uwoneke moyo wosatha

hymns.title: M'khola, m'khola
verses:
1. M'khola, m'khola
M'khola la ng'ombe (x2)
Kuli Yesu, Yesu wabadwa,
wabadwa, wabadwa
Kuli Yesu, Yesu wabadwa, M'khola la ng'ombe

2. Abusa, abusa
Abusa a Betlehemu (x2)
Adaona, ona angelo, angelo, angelo
Adaona, ona angelo oyimba, Hosanna!

3. Anzeru, anzeru
Anzeru aku m'mawa (x2)
Adatsata, tsata nyenyezi, nyenyezi nyenyezi
Adatsata, tsata nyenyezi, napeza Yesuyo

4. Pofika, pofika
Pofika ku Betlehemu (x2)
Adaona, ona mwanayo, mwanayo, mwanayo
Adaona, ona mwanayo natama Mulungu

hymns.title: Sankha yako, sankha yako
Ambuye alitu Thanthwe
verses:
1. Ambuye alitu Thanthwe
M'mene ndibisalamo
Potchinjiriza namondwe
Odwala ndi olemawo

2. Mafunde akagundafe
Nthawi ya namondweyo
Alipo wothandiza'fe
Nthawi ya namondweyo

3. Lingatu la usikuwo
Nthawi ya namondwe
Osaopa moopsyamo
Nthawiya namondweyo
hymns.chorus:
O! Yesu ndiye thanthwe kwa olematu
Olematu, olematu
O! Yesu ndiye thanthwe kwa olematu
Pa nthawi ya namondweyo

hymns.title: Kodi mwafunsa Yesu za kutsuka kwake?
verses:
1. Kodi mwafunsa Yesu za kutsuka kwake?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mwakhulupilira chisomocho?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

2. Kodi mukuyenda ndi mpulumutsiyo?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mwapuma pa mtanda wa Yesu?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

3. Kodi mwakonzeka pakubwera kwake?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
Kodi mukalowa m'malo abwino?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?
hymns.chorus:
Kodi mwatsukidwa ndi mwazi woyera wa Yesu?
Kodi zobvala zanu ndi zoyera?
Kodi mwasamba m'mwazi wake?

hymns.title: Chipata chochinjikako
verses:
1. Chipata chochinjikako
Chionetsera cheza;
Kuchokatu kwa mtandawo
Chikondi chioneka

2. Chipata n'chauleretu
Kwa onse akufuna
Achuma, osaukanso,
Amtundu uliwonse

3. Pitanitu mtsogolomo
Chipata nchosatseka
Landira mtanda wakewo
Mbonitu ya chikondi

4. Patsidya tidzatulapo
Mtandawo wa manyazi
Dzabvalatu koronayo
Dzamkonda 'Ye koposa
hymns.chorus:
Mwatchinjikira ine'ko Chipata chakumwamwako?
Ine, ine mwatchinjikira ine

hymns.title: Ndalimva dziko la mtalimo
verses:
1. Ndalimva dziko la mtalimo
Munthu sangathe kulisimba
Malowo awala koposa
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

2. Musazengereze anthuni
Chimwemwe uko chilipodi
Anthuni mudzalandiradi
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

3. Mwana'we patseni mtimako
Akuchotsere zoipazo
Udzakhala wokondweradi,
E! Nkwabwino lola mwana'we

4. Idzani, mverani, lapani
Chipulumutso chiripodi
Kwa Yesu yemwe woferanu
Ndi Yesu mudzanka kumwamba
hymns.chorus:
Komweko, komweko
Ndi Yesu tidzakhala uko

hymns.title: Mundipatse mafuta a m'nyali
verses:
1. Mundipatse mafuta a m'nyali
Ndipemphatu Ambuye'nu
Mundipatse mafuta a m'nyali
Ndiyakebe mpaka mudzanso

2. Mundiyendetse ndinu Ambuye
Mundiphunzitse inutu
Mundiyendetse ndinu Ambuye
Ndiphunzire mpaka mudzanso

3. Mundikhalitse pansi pa mtanda
Ndipemphatu Ambuye'Nu
Mundikhalitse pansi pa mtanda
Ndigonjetu mpaka mudzanso

4. Mundipatse mtendere m'timanga
Ndipemphatu Ambuye'Nu
Mundipatse mtendere m'timanga
Ndipumule mpaka mudzanso

5. Mundipatse chimwemwe m'timanga
Ndipemphatu Ambuye Nu
Mundipatse chimwemwe m'timanga
Ndiyimbire mpaka mudzanso
hymns.chorus:
Yimbirani, yimbirani
Hosana kwa mfumu ya mafumuyo!
Yimbirani, yimbirani
Hosana kwa mfumuyo!

hymns.title: Yesu afuna inu kukhala
verses:
1. Yesu afuna inu kukhala
Kuti timvere mau ake okoma

2. Ngati sitikondana ndi Yesu
Pobwera Yesu tidzazunzidwa

3. Anthu ati "Nafe tikapuma"
Koma sadziwa kupuma kwake

4. Yesu ati "Idzani mupumule"
Ine ndine mpumulo wa moyo

5. Mukafuna moyo mudzapeza;
Mtendere udzakhala ndi inu

6. Kodi mufuna moyo wosatha?
Mverani Yesu mwana wa Mulungu
hymns.chorus:
Lowani, lowani, lowani, Yesu sakana
Lowani, lowani, lowani, Yesu sakana

hymns.title: Mwazi wa Mbuyanga Yesu
verses:
1. Mwazi wa Mbuyanga Yesu
Wanditsukatu
Wopanduka ndi woipa
Ndayera mbuu!

2. Mwaziwo wandiombola
Watha mulanduwo
Ndakhululukidwa nawo
Ndayera mbuu!

3. Pa maso pake pa Mulungu
Ndingafikepo
Wosaopa ndi wokondwa
Ndayera mbuu!

4. Wakugonjetsa satana
Ndiwo mwaziwo
M'nkhondoyo ndimapambana
Ndayera mbuu!

5. M'mwambamo ndidzayimbira
Mwazi wa Yesu
Ndidzaona nkhope yake
Ntayera mbuu!
hymns.chorus:
Khulupira mwazi wake
Wa Mbuyeyo
Mulandire m'mtima mwako
Mphamvu yakeyo

hymns.title: Simphamvu, sinkhondo
verses:
1. Simphamvu, sinkhondo
Koma Mzimu wa Ambuye
Mapiri asunthidwa
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

2. Machimo adzachoka
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

3. Nthendazo zidzachira
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

4. Yesu abatiza
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

5. Nkhondoyo idzaleka
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

6. Mtendere udzakhala
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

7. Yesuyo adzabwera
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

8. Ifenso tidzauka
Ndi Mzimu wa Ambuye

hymns.title: Zonena zake za Yesu
verses:
1. Zonena zake za Yesu
Anong'oneza Mbuyathu,
Musakanize Mbuyathu
Tamlandirani leroli,
E! leroli, E! leroli,
Tamlandirani leroli.

2. Mufufunuka bwanjiko
Musadafike pabwino?
Panjira musachedwapo
Pulumukani tsopano
Ochedwapo, ochedwapo
Pulumukani tsopano

3. Chikondi chake cha Yesu
Chikhwekhweretsa nonsenu
Kuti mukhale akhristu
Tabweranitu mwamsanga
E! nonsenu, E! nonsenu,
Tabweranitu mwamsanga

4. Mulungu ngwachifundodi,
Inde sadzakukanani,
Mitima yanu mpatseni,
Adzaikonza leroli,
E! leroli, E! leroli,
Adzaikonza leroli.

hymns.title: Kuseli kwa mitambo yonse yophimbayo
verses:
1. Kuseli kwa mitambo yonse yophimbayo
Komweko ndi chimwemwe chonse chomalizatu

2. E! maso a mitima yathu aonako,
Amatimvetsa bwino Yesu za dziko la kalelo

3. Abale athu onka kale tidzawaona
Osalekana ife konse pofika kwathuko

4. Chisoni ndi zowawa zonse zidzachoka;
Misozi wakupukuta yekhayekha Yesu.
hymns.chorus:
Uko zidzaleka zonse zotibvutazo
Etu! Tikhale bwino ife
Uko, kumwambako

hymns.title: Inu mwamandotanso, Yesu akwitana
verses:
1. Inu mwamandotanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwamandotanso, Yesu akwitana

2. Inu mwamafumunso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwamafumunso, Yesu akwitana

3. Inu mwa amayinso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa amayinso, Yesu akwitana

4. Inu okalambanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu okalambanso, Yesu akwitana

5. Inu mwa tiananso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa tiananso, Yesu akwitana

6. Inu mwa'nyamatanso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa'nyamatanso, Yesu akwitana

7. Inu mwa mauthunso, Yesu akwitana
Inu mwa mauthunso, Yesu akwitana
hymns.chorus:
Dzani 'dzani dzanitu!
Idzani inu nonse Yesu akwitana

hymns.title: Pa mtanda Mbuye adafera
verses:
1. Pa mtanda Mbuye adafera
Ndidadzapo ndi tchimo langa
Pomwe mtima wanga watsukidwa,
Ulemelero

2. Ndapulumuka modabwitsa
Yesu analowa mu mtimanga,
Pa mtanda adandilandira
Ulemelero

3. Chitsime chotsukira tchimo
Ndikondwa kuti ndalowanso,
Momwe amandidyetseramo,
Ulemelero

4. Bwera ku chitsime chokoma
'Dzigwetsere pa phazi lake,
Lumphamo lero utsukidwe,
Ulemelero
hymns.chorus:
Ulemelero kwa dzina lake
Pomwe mtimanga watsukidwa,
Ulemelero

hymns.title: Wabadwa, wabadwa, Mpulumutsi
verses:
1. Wabadwa, wabadwa, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa
Wabadwa, wabadwa, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa
Mngelo adasimba, Mpulumutsi Wabadwa, (Alleluya)
Wabadwa, wabadwa, mpulumutsi Yesuyo wabadwa

2. Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,
Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,
Mngelo adasimba, wauka kwa akufa, (Alleluya)
Wauka, wauka, Mpulumutsi Yesuyo wauka,

3. Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka
Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka
Zoipa zonse zachoka m'mwazi wake wa Yesu. (Alleluya)
Wachoka, wachoka katundu, wa mu mtima wachoka

hymns.title: Mwazi udatsika pa mtanda tidaona
verses:
1. Mwazi udatsika pa mtanda tidaona
Kutsuka ife unaali wa mtengo wapatali
O! Yesudi mdafera chifukwa cha ife;
Pa mtandapo onani mwaziwo woyenda

2. Ha! Kulemera mtandawo Mbuye nasenza
Womwe udamgwetsa Iye ku Gologotako.

3. Yesu mudadzukanso kumanda lero lino
Mudati, mwatha ntchito ya kupulumutsa anthu

4. Ambuye mudatiwombola ndi mwazi wanu
Chifukwa cha chikondi chanu Chopambanacho.

5. O! Yesu tikukondani tonsefe, tibwera
Chifukwa inu ndinu mwini Wamphamvu yonse.

hymns.title: Ndafika m'dziko lokoma
verses:
1. Ndafika m'dziko lokoma
Ndi zinthu zonsezo zanga;
Chisoni chonse chidzatha
Chimwemwe chokha chikhala

2. Wopulumutsa Yesuyo
Anditsogoza m'njirayo;
Alankhulana nanetu
Mpaka ndifike komweko

3. Ndiyimba za cholowachi
Ndidza chimwemwe chosatha
Chifundo chake chikhala
Pa anthu onse oyimba

4. Angelo onse ayimba
Za zinthu zonse zam'mwamba
Mipingo yonse ya Mulungu
Iyimba za mombolo'yo
hymns.chorus:
Ha! Dzikolo lokomadi
Ndingoima paphiripo
Ndiyang'anira komweko ku nyumba zokonzedwazo
Ndiyang'anira dzikolo komwe ndidzakakhalako

hymns.title: Mibvumbi ya madalitso
verses:
1. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Ili ndi lonjezano
Lidzadza nyengo ya mvula
Yotumidwa ndi Mbuye

2. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Yotitsitsimutsanso;
Pa mapiri ndi pa madambo
Pamvekedwe mvulayo

3. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Bwenzi itatigwera;
Kwa Mulungu tibvomereza
Kwa Yesu tiitana

4. Mibvumbi ya madalitso,
Ngati timvera ife;
Mvulayo itsanulidwa
Monga kufuna kwake.
hymns.chorus:
Mibvumbi ndiyo, ya madalitso idze
Madontho akugwa koma, mibvumbiyo itsike

hymns.title: Ndirikuliranji?
verses:
1. Ndirikuliranji?
Sizikwana nsonizo
Kuleketsa, manthawo
Kuulula machimo
Kundipulumutsa

2. Ndikangamiranji?
Maganizo ndi nchito
Zonse zanga zabwino
Zomwe zili mtimamo
Sizindilamitsa

3. Ndili kuchedwanji?
Wotayika, wofoka
Wakuchita zoipa;
Ndikachedwa ndidzafa
Wosapulumuka

4. Ndipulupudzanji?
Yesu, ntchito adatha
Yakundipulumutsa.
Mbuye mundithandize
Kukhulupilira.
hymns.chorus:
Yesu Khristu nalira,
Nandifera pa mtanda;
Ndipo andilindira
Kundipulumutsa

hymns.title: Mkulu anadza kwa Yesu Mbuye
verses:
1. Mkulu anadza kwa Yesu Mbuye
Nafunsira Iye za moyo wina
Yesu adatero kwa wofunsayo
"Ukabadwensotu"

2. Nonsenu akumva mau omwewo
Adalankhulidwa ndi mfumu ija
Musapeputsebe zonena zake
Mukabadwensotu

3. Anthunu ofuna kupuma kwake
Kuyimba kumwamba za kuombola
Moyowo umene mudzakhala nawo
Mukabadwensotu

4. Ambiri ambiri amasochera
Mu njira ya imfa akunyengedwa
Idzani kwa Yesu mkhulupirireni
Ndikubadwansotu

hymns.title: E Kwathu ndi kumwambako
verses:
1. E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
E Kwathu ndi kumwambako,
Tidzakondwerako
Tiyeni ku mwamba ndi Ambuye Yesu
Tiyeni ku mwamba tidzakondwerako

2. E Mudzitembenukatu,
E Mudzitemhenukatu,
E Mudzitembenukatu,
Kukakondwerako.

3. Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Muyeretsedwe m'mtimamo,
Kukakondwerako.

4. Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukhale olungamatu,
Mukakondwerako.

5. M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
M'menyane ndi zoipazo,
Kukakondwerako.

6. Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Musenze msanga mtandawo,
Kukakondwerako.

hymns.title: Yesu apita pano
verses:
1. Yesu apita pano, pano, pano,
Yesu apita pano, apita pano lero.

2. Yesu afuna iwe, iwe, iwe,
Yesu afuna iwe, afuna iwe lero.

3. Yesu afuna ine, ine, ine,
Yesu afuna ine, afuna ine lero

4. Yesu akonda ine, ine, ine,
Yesu akonda ine, akonda ine lero

hymns.title: Yesu ndidzina
verses:
1. Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, la Mbuye
Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, Yesu ndidzina, la Mbuye
Aleluya, Aleluya, Yesu ndi dzina la Mbuye
Aleluya, Aleluya, Yesu ndi dzina la Mbuye

2. Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, kwa dziko
Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, Yesu nkuunika, kwa dziko

3. Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate wa moyo
Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate, Yesu ndi mkate wa moyo

4. Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi a moyo
Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi, Yesu ndi madzi a moyo.

5. Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira ya moyo
Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira, Yesu ndi njira ya moyo

6. Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo lamoyo
Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo, Yesu ndi khomo lamoyo

7. Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa wabwino
Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa, Yesu ndi Mbusa wabwino

hymns.title: Mwand'itana, ndabvomera
verses:
1. Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Mwand'itana, ndabvomera,
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

2. M'midzi yonse ndidzayenda, (katatu)
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

3. Kuli konse ndidzapita, (katatu)
Ndidzakutumikirani, Ambuye.

hymns.title: Yesu adampatsa madziwo amoyo
verses:
1. Yesu adampatsa madziwo amoyo,
Yesu adampatsa madziwo amoyo,
Napita nasimbira. Nabwerera ndi ena,
Iwonso adafuna madziwo a moyo

2. Yesu apatsabe madziwo amoyowo,
Yesu apatsabe madziwo amoyowo,
Kwa wokhulupilira ndi wakumulandira,
Yesutu apatsabe madziwo a moyo

3. Madzi otumphukira kumoyo wosatha,
Madzi otumphukira kumoyo wosatha,
Mumtimamu mwa Khristu, Kasupeyo wa madzi
Amatumphukira kumoyo wosatha

hymns.title: Chenjera ndi maso ako
verses:
1. Chenjera ndi maso ako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi maso ako, chenjera.

2. Chenjera ndi khutu lako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi khutu lako, chenjera

3. Chenjera ndi mkamwa mwako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi mkamwa mwako, chenjera

4. Chenjera ndi manja ako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi manja ako, chenjera

5. Chenjerandi phazi lako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi phazi lako, chenjera

6. Chenjera ndi mtima wako, chenjera (kawiri)
Mpulumutsi Yesuyo Akusuzumiradi
Chenjera ndi mtima wako, chenjera

hymns.title: Wanzeru anamanga pathanthwe
verses:
1. Wanzeru anamanga pathanthwe,
Namanga nyumba yake pathanthwe
Wanzeru anamanga pathanthwe,
Ndipo mvula idagwa
Mvula niigwaigwabe, Mvula, niigwaigwabe
Mphepo idagundanso, nyumba niima nji!

2. Wopusa anamanga pa mchenga,
Namanga nyumba yake pa mchenga
Wopusa anamanga pa mchenga
Ndipo mvula idagwa
Mvula niigwaigwabe, Mvula, niigwaigwabe
Mphepo idagundadi, nyumba idagwa phii!

hymns.title: Tchimo langa lonseli lachotsedwa
verses:
1. Tchimo langa lonseli lachotsedwa,
Lachotsedwa, lachotsedwa
Tchimo langa lonseli lachotsedwapo pamtandapo

2. Mtendere walowa m'tima mwanga,
M'tima mwanga, m'tima mwanga
Mtendere walowa m'tima mwanga, pamtandapo

3. Chimwemwe chalowa m'tima mwanga,
M'tima mwanga, m'tima mwanga
Chimwemwe chalowa m'tima mwanga, pamtandapo/

hymns.title: Mitengo imagwedezeka
verses:
1. Mitengo imagwedezeka,
Imagwedezeka, imagwedezeka
Mitengo imagwedezeka, kutama Ambuye

2. Udzunso umagwedezeka,
Umagwedezeka, umagwedezeka
Udzunso umagwedezeka, kutama Ambuye

3. Pereka mtima wako wonse,
Mtima wako wonse, mtima wako wonse
Pereka mtima wako wonse, kutama Ambuye

hymns.title: Kanyali kanga kakang'ono
verses:
1. Kanyali kanga kakang'ono
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

2. Bisa pansi padengu, ayi
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

3. Satana asazime phuu!
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

4. M'dziko la Malawi!
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Ndikaleke kawale,
Kawale, kawalire Yesu

hymns.title: Pemphera nthawi ya m'mamawa
verses:
1. Pemphera nthawi ya m'mamawa
Pemphera nthawi ya usana
Pemphera nthawi ya usiku, m'tima m'timamo

2. Ayankha nthawi ya m'mamawa
Ayankha nthawi ya masana
Ayankha nthawi ya usiku, konzeka m'tima

3. Angadze nthawi ya m'mamawa
Angadze nthawi ya masana
Angadze nthawi ya madzulo, konzeka m'tima

hymns.title: Mtima wanga uyamiketu
verses:
1. Mtima wanga uyamiketu
Mfumu yangayo kumwambako
Mtima wanga uyamiketu
Zokoma zake za Yesu

2. Ndiyamika Yesu wangayo
Anandifera, adaukanso
Andipempherera m'Mwambamo
Abweranso kutenga'ne
hymns.chorus:
Yesu, Yesu, Yesu,
Inu nokhadi
Ndikuyamikani
Ambuye wamoyotu

hymns.title: Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
verses:
1. Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Mnzako akufa m'madzi ndithu
M'madzi atchimo akumiramo
Tam'gwiratu m'sanga asanafemo

2. Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Uzengereza chifukwa ninji
Ona aimira posachedwatu
Utenge msanga bwato la moyo

3. Ali kufadi anthu ambiri
Omira m'nsoni mosalowa'we
M'mafumde a tsoka abiramo bii
Aponyere chingwe atulukemo

4. Chingwe cha moyo ndichotu Yesu
M'madzi atchimo atitulutsa
Atikometsa tisalowenso
Mombolo wathuyo ndiye Yesu
hymns.chorus:
Chingwe cha moyo tamponyeratu
Ali kumira ndithudi
Chingwe chamoyo msangatu msanga
Apulumuke nacho

hymns.title: Akondwera lero akumwambawo
verses:
1. Akondwera lero akumwambawo
Alikudza wosocherayo;
Ndi Atate akomana nayetu
Amachingamira mwanayo

2. Dzulo adagona m'thengo moopsya
Lero adzagona m'kholamo
Dzulo idam'gwira njala ya mtima
Lero Yesu amudyetsatu

3. Dzulo kumva ludzu mkamwa muli gwa!
Lero anamwa madzi amoyo
Dzulo adavala nsanza zakezo
Lero Yesu amubvekatu

4. Kale adachita zosayenera
Lero alekana nazo
Dzulo nubvutika mtima wakewo
Lero akondwerera nafetu.
hymns.chorus:
Yimba, yimba, tiyimbitsetu!
Imva, imva akumwambanso,
Pakuona anthu ochulukawo,
Ndiwo ake ake a Yesu

hymns.title: Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
verses:
1. Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
Mau a Mulungu, mau a Mulungu
Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mukawerenga Mau a Mulungu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu

2. Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku
Tsiku ndi tsiku, tsiku ndi tsiku
Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mudzakula mwa Yesu
Mukapemphera tsiku ndi tsiku
Mudzakula mwa Yesu

hymns.title: Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu
verses:
1. Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu
Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu
Ndatsimikiza kutsata Yesu
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

2. Ngakhale ndekha
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Ngakhale ndekha
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Ngakhale ndekha
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

3. Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo
Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo
Za mdziko mbuyo mtanda m'tsogolo
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo

4. Ngakhale m'bvuto
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Ngakhale m'bvuto
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Ngakhale m'bvuto
Ndidzam'ngotsata
Osabwerera bwerera m'mbuyo.

hymns.title: Ndiri ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
verses:
1. Ndiri ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
mum'timangamu
Ndiri ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

2. Ndiri ndi mtendere wopambana
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
mum'timangamu
Ndiri ndi mtendere wopambana
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

3. Ndiri naye mzimu woyera
Mum'timangamu, mum'timangamu
mum'timangamu
Ndiri naye mzimu woyera
Mum'timangamu, Aleluya

hymns.title: Ndapulumutsidwa
verses:
1. Ndapulumutsidwa,
Ndapulumutsidwa,
Ndi mwazi wake wa Yesu,
Ndapulumutsidwa

2. Ndakhululukidwa, ndakhululukidwa
Ndi mwazi wake wa Yesu,
Ndakhululukidwa

3. Ndatchinjirizidwa,
Ndatchinjirizidwa,
Ndi moyo wake wa Yesu,
Ndatchinjirizidwa.

4. Ndayanjanitsidwa,
Ndayanjanitsidwa,
Ndi mwana wake wa Mulungu,
Ndayanjanitsidwa.

hymns.title: Anthu onse adziwe
verses:
1. Anthu onse adziwe, anthu onse adziwe
Ayenera adziwe, Mbuye Yesu
Ndiye wakukoma mtima, ndiye wopambanatu,
Ndiye mpulumutsi wanga, anthu onse adziwe

2. Anthu onse adziwe, anthu onse adziwe
Ayenera adziwe, ntchito yake
Yesu adafera ife, nasauka pamtanda
Kuti tikalowe m'mwamba, tikakhale nayeko.

hymns.title: Anyamata, asungwana
verses:
1. Anyamata, asungwana mtsateni'nu mtsateni
Afunitsa inu nonse mtsateni'nu mtsateni
Anapeza mavutowo napereka moyo wake
Namwa ndulu m'malo mwathu mtsateni'nu mtsateni.

hymns.title: Imbani nyimbo mumtima
verses:
1. Imbani nyimbo mumtima, imbani nyimbo mumtima
Imbani nyimbo mumtima kwa Mfumu ya mafumu
Mulambireni iye mulemekezeni
Imbani nyimbo mumtima kwa Mfumu ya mafumu

hymns.title: Yesu wandifera
verses:
1. Yesu wandifera, Yesu wandifera
Ndimkondadi chifukwa wandifera

hymns.title: Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mugwe pa ine
verses:
1. Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mugwe pa ine
Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mugwe pa ine
Mundikonze, mundikonze
Mzimu wa Mulungu'Nu mundidzaze'ne

hymns.title: Dzuwa liwala, dzuwa la m'mwamba
verses:
1. Dzuwa liwala, dzuwa la m'mwamba
Liunikira mu mtima mwanga
O Aleluya! Ndisekerera
Ndiitane Yesu ali wanga

hymns.title: Tiwaliretu, tiwaliretu
verses:
1. Tiwaliretu, tiwaliretu
Ambuye Yesu watikondafe
Mulemekeze'ye tsiku lonseli
Inde tiwarire Yesu

hymns.title: Mulungu ngwokoma andithandiza
verses:
1. Mulungu ngwokoma andithandiza
Andigwira dzanja langa
Mulungu ngwokoma.

hymns.title: Mau akhale amoyo
verses:
1. Mau akhale amoyo
Ndione Inu momwemo
Ndione ndekha, ndione Yesu
Ndione zonsezo.

hymns.title: Ndiri ndi chuma chozizwa
verses:
1. Ndiri ndi chuma chozizwa
Mphatso yosayeseka
Tidzayenda limodzi Baibulo landa ndi ine.

hymns.title: Timkonde Ambuye, timkonde Ambuye
verses:
1. Timkonde Ambuye, timkonde Ambuye
Chifukwa amatikonda, timkonde Ambuye
Timvere Ambuye, timvere Ambuye
Chifukwa amatikonda, timvere Ambuye

hymns.title: Uzani Yesu, Uzani Yesu
verses:
1. Uzani Yesu, Uzani Yesu
Ndiye bwenzi lomveka
Kulibe bwenzi lina lotere
Uzani Yesu yekha

hymns.title: Uza ena, uza ena
verses:
1. Uza ena, uza ena, fulumira, uza ena
Yesu awakonda nawafera pamtanda
Fulumira, uza ena.

hymns.title: Zakeyu anali wamfupifupi
verses:
1. Zakeyu anali wamfupifupi
M'mkuyu nakweramo
Kuti akaone Yesu Mbuye, Mwana wa Mulungutu
Pofika Yesu pa mkuyu anaona Zakeyu
Nanena Zakeyu tsika lero ndidya nanu.

hymns.title: Yesu alinane tsiku lonse
verses:
1. Yesu alinane tsiku lonse
Pantchito ndi pa masewera
Kwathu ndi kwina konseko
Kodi ndimukonda wondisungayo?

hymns.title: Taona! Taona! Ndaima pakhomo ndigogoda
verses:
1. Taona! Taona! Ndaima pakhomo ndigogoda
Taona! Taona! Ndaima pakhomo ndigogoda
Anyamata akumva mau anga
Asungwana akumva mau anga
Nakatsegula, tsegula, tsegula chitseko,
Ndidzalowa

hymns.title: Khalanitu, khulupiradi
verses:
1. Khalanitu, khulupiradi,
Khalanitu, mwachikondicho
Khalanitu, penyetsetsa'ye
Mwa Yesu khalanitu

hymns.title: Anandilondola nditasokera kutaliko
verses:
1. Anandilondola nditasokera kutaliko;
Anandipezadi, nlodalatu tsikulo

hymns.title: Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu
verses:
1. Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu
Asodzi a anthu, asodzi a anthu
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu,
Mukanditsata
Mukanditsata, mukanditsata
Mudzakhala asodzi a anthu,
Mukanditsata.

hymns.title: Ali wodabwitsa, Yesuyo
verses:
1. Ali wodabwitsa, Yesuyo
Ali wodabwitsa, Yesuyo
Maso sanaone, makutu sanamve
Zodabwitsa zonse za Yesuyo.

hymns.title: Andisungadi, andisungadi
verses:
1. Andisungadi, andisungadi
Yesu andikonda ine andisungadi.

hymns.title: Yang'anani kwa Yesu
verses:
1. Yang'anani kwa Yesu
Penyani nkhope yakeyo
Ndi chisomo chake cha Yesuyo
Chikwanitsa zofuna zanu

hymns.title: Yesu wanga ndikonda'Nu
verses:
1. Yesu wanga ndikonda'Nu
Ndikupatsani mtimanga
Lowani lero, khalani muno
Lowani mtimanga Yesu.

hymns.title: Lankhula naye Yesu zobvutazo
verses:
1. Lankhula naye Yesu zobvutazo,
Lankhula naye Yesu, Iye amvatu
Pa kuyesedwa'we wamphamvu ndi Iyeyu
Polankhula naye athandizatu.

hymns.title: Yesu yemwe adzabweranso
verses:
1. Yesu yemwe adzabweranso
Adzakhala mfumu ponsepo
Titdzamuona Iye nthawi yomweyo
Dikiranitu.

hymns.title: Chimwemwe, chimwemwe chachikulu
verses:
1. Chimwemwe, chimwemwe chachikulu
Haya, haya, haya, tisangalaletu
Zochimwa zanga zonse afuna kuzichotsa
Abwera msangamsanga posachedwatu.

hymns.title: Ndanitu? Ndanitu? Adzatsata Yesu?
verses:
1. Ndanitu? Ndanitu? Adzatsata Yesu? Ndani?
Tsatani Iyeyo tsopanoli, tsata Yesudi.

hymns.title: Khala monga Danieli
verses:
1. Khala monga Danieli, limba mtima nji!
Usaope anthu, koma tsata Yesudi.

hymns.title: Ayenera kukondedwa, Yesu Mpulumutsiyo
verses:
1. Ayenera kukondedwa, Yesu Mpulumutsiyo
Ayenera akondedwe, adasenza machimo
Wokondedwa wa Mulungu, nazunzidwa pa mtanda
Ayenera kukondedwa, Yesu Mpulumutsiyo

hymns.title: Timange nyumba zathu, zathu
verses:
1. Timange nyumba zathu, zathu, tsiku, tsiku ndi tsiku
Nyundo, nkhwangwa tiribe
Nkhuni, njerwa tiribe
Nanga opanda manjatu, tsata chitsanzo cha Yesu
Ndife a ntchito otani, omanga bwino makhalidwe?

hymns.title: Manja agwire za Yesu
verses:
1. Manja agwire za Yesu,
Mapazi ayende mwake,
Makutu amve Uthenga
Milomo imyamikire,
Maso apenyere Iye,
Mtima ukhale wake
Zonse ndipatse kwa Yesu,
"Ndine wanu, nokha'Nu"

hymns.title: Yesu amakonda ana, ana, onse pansipo
verses:
1. Yesu amakonda ana, ana, onse pansipo
Amitundu yonseyo, akuda ndi oyera
Yesu amakonda ana onsewo.

hymns.title: Ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
verses:
1. Ndi chimwemwe chachikulu
Chikho changa chisefuka
Yesu andipulumutsa, Yesu andikwaniritsa
Chikho changa chisefuka.

hymns.title: Zikomo Ambuye wanga
verses:
1. Zikomo Ambuye wanga, zikomo mnandichiritsa
Zikomo mnandipatsatu chipulumutso chachikulu

hymns.title: Odala ali anthu odziwa Yesu
verses:
1. Odala ali anthu odziwa Yesu
Otsukidwa m'mwazi wake, oyeratu mbuu!
Mtendere, chipulumutso, chimwemwe ndi zawo
Odala ali anthu odziwa Yesu.

hymns.title: Chisomo chodabwitsa chopezekatu pa mtanda
verses:
1. Chisomo chodabwitsa chopezekatu pa mtanda
Chokwanira ndi chosatha cha Ambuye Yesu.

hymns.title: Wopambana, wopambana Yesu wa mtanda ngwopambana
verses:
1. Wopambana, wopambana Yesu wa mtanda ngwopambana
Pa mapazi ake tonse timgwadira
Yesu Ambuyeyo ngwopambana.

hymns.title: Yesu adatipulumutsa ndi ntchito yakeyo
verses:
1. Yesu adatipulumutsa ndi ntchito yakeyo
Sadadza kuweruza dziko koma kupulumutsa
Timati: Mpulumutsi, Timati: Mpulumutsi
Timati: Mpulumutsi, Dzina labwinotu

hymns.title: Khulupira Mulungu, ndiye Bwenzi ndithu
verses:
1. Khulupira Mulungu, ndiye Bwenzi ndithu
Taya pa Yesu nkhawa zonse, ama-samalira,
Yimba ndi usana wabwino
Yimba ndi usiku wa mdima;
Tsiku lonse, njira zonse
Tiyeni tiyimbe.

hymns.title: Mulibe nsonizo m'nyumba Mwambamo
verses:
1. Mulibe nsonizo m'nyumba Mwambamo
Ya Atatewo a Kumwambako
Mulibe nsonizo m'nyumba Mwambamo
Muli chimwemwe chokhacho.

hymns.title: Nditsate Yesu tsiku ndi tsiku
verses:
1. Nditsate Yesu tsiku ndi tsiku
Sindidzaopa atsogoleri
M'dzuwa ndi m'nthunzi
Yesu mpulumutsi ali nane.

hymns.title: Mtima uda bii!
verses:
1. Mtima uda bii!
Mpaka Yesu walowa
Mwazi wake ndidziwa wandiyeretsa mbu!
M'mau ake ndikuzidwa ndidzayenda Kumwamba
Tsiku lodabwitsadi, wanditsuka machimo.

hymns.title: Yesu m'ndikumbutse ine zomwe ndaphunziratu
verses:
1. Yesu m'ndikumbutse ine zomwe ndaphunziratu
Lembani pamtima panga zoonadi zanuzo
Dalitsani'fe Ambuye mpaka tisonkhananso
Mtitsogolere nthawi zonse, Mpulumutsi wathu'nu Amen.

hymns.title: Indetu, indetu nditi kwa inu
verses:
1. Indetu, indetu nditi kwa inu
Indetu, indetu tamveranitu
Okhulupilira Yesu ali ndi moyo wosatha.

hymns.title: Tsegula m'mtima, Yesu agogoda
verses:
1. Tsegula m'mtima, Yesu agogoda
Tsegula m'mtima, usazengereze
Tsegula m'mtima, Yesu agogoda
Iwe tsegula alowe

hymns.title: Odala oyera mtima
verses:
1. Odala oyera mtima
Odala oyera mtima
Odala oyera mtima
Adzaona Mulungu.

hymns.title: Ndiri nkudya mkate wa moyo
verses:
1. Ndiri nkudya mkate wa moyo
Ndiri kumwa madzi a moyo
Iye wakumwa ati Yesu
Ndithu sadzamvanso ludzu
(Asungwana) kodi, sadzamvanso ludzu?
(Anyamata) inde, sadzamvanso ludzu
Iye wakumwa ati Yesu
Ndithu sadzamvanso ludzu

hymns.title: Wandimasula, wandimasula
verses:
1. Wandimasula, wandimasula
Sindidzayenda m'uchimo
Yesu ndiyetu mombolo wanga
Tsiku ndi tsiku akhale nane

hymns.title: Yesu Ambuye, andikondadi
verses:
1. Yesu Ambuye, andikondadi
Nafera ine ndipulumuke
Adaukadi nigonja imfa,
Adzabweranso ndisangalale.

hymns.title: Akhala mumtima mwanga
verses:
1. Akhala mumtima mwanga
Akhala mumtima mwanga
Sindiopa kanthu ka ufiti omwe
Pokhala mumtima Yesu.

hymns.title: Mtame Yesu nthawi ya mamawa
verses:
1. Mtame Yesu nthawi ya mamawa
Nthawi ya masana
Mtame Yesu pamene dzuwa lilowa
Aleluya!

hymns.title: Uku ndi uko monga nyanjatu
verses:
1. Uku ndi uko monga nyanjatu
Chikondi cha Yesu chimandizinga

hymns.title: Tidzamuona Iye
verses:
1. Tidzamuona Iye, Tidzamuona Iye
Tidzamuona Iye, m'muulemelero wake

hymns.title: Lamulo langa ndilo
verses:
1. Lamulo langa ndilo;
Mukondane wina ndi m'nzake
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale
Lamulo langa ndilo;
Mukondane wina ndi m'nzake
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale
Lamulo langa ndilo;
Mukondane wina ndi m'nzake
Chimwemwe chanu chidzale

hymns.title: Mphotho yake ya uchimo ndi imfa
verses:
1. Mphotho yake ya uchimo ndi imfa
Mphotho yake ya uchimo ndi imfa
Koma mphotho yaulere ya Mulungu
Ndiyo moyo wosatha.

hymns.title: Yendani poyera, yendani poyera
verses:
1. Yendani poyera, yendani poyera
Tsagana ndi Yesu
Adzathandiza ifenso

hymns.title: Zingakhale zoipa zafiira
verses:
1. Zingakhale zoipa zafiira, ziyera, ziyera,
M'mwazi wa Yesu
Zikafira ngati kapezi zidzakhala mbuu,
M'mwazi wa Yesu

hymns.title: Ponsepo, ponsepo, sindidzaopa
verses:
1. Ponsepo, ponsepo, sindidzaopa
Ponsepo ndi Yesu
Ndidzapita.

hymns.title: Ndani agogoda pa mtima panga?
verses:
1. Ndani agogoda pa mtima panga?
Ndi Yesu Ambuye, ndi Yesu Ambuye
Afuna alowe.
Kodi akalowa akufuna chiyani?
Kukupulumutsa'we.

hymns.title: Ndine mwana wa nkhosa wa Mbusa wabwino
verses:
1. Ndine mwana wa nkhosa wa Mbusa wab-wino
Ndiye Yesu, amakonda nkhosa zake zonse
Adafera pa mtanda kuti aziwombole
Kuti zonse zikhale m'khola mwake.

hymns.title: Chikondi cha Yesu cholingatu m'mwambamo
verses:
1. Chikondi cha Yesu cholingatu
m'mwambamo
N'chakuya kuposatu nyanjazo
Wosayenera'ne andisamaliratu
Chikondi chakecho chimandizingatu
ponsepo

hymns.title: Manga pa thanthwe siidzagwedezeka
verses:
1. Manga pa thanthwe siidzagwedezeka
Manga pa thanthwe, osati pa mchenga
Adzaopa namondwe kapena bingu
Uli wosungidwa pomanga pa Yesu

hymns.title: Yesu mbusa wanga ndiyenda nayetu
verses:
1. Yesu mbusa wanga ndiyenda nayetu
Kumadzi odikha anditsogolera
Nsiku zonse ndiyenda nayetu
Nsiku zonse ndiyenda nayetu.

hymns.title: Mukhale nafe Yesu, mumphamvu yanu
verses:
1. Mukhale nafe Yesu, mumphamvu yanu
Chipembedzo chathu mudalitsetu

hymns.title: Ambuye adzanditsogolera mkati mwa chipululu
verses:
1. Ambuye adzanditsogolera mkati mwa
chipululu
Ambuye adzanditsogolera,
ine ndidzangomtsata
Mphamvu yake adzandipatsa
Ya lero ndi ya mawa yomwe
Ambuye adzanditsogolera,
ine ndidzangomtsata.

hymns.title: Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu
verses:
1. Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Chikondi cha Yesu nchodabwitsatu,
Ee! Nchodabwitsa!
N'chachikulu sungachizungulire
N'chakuya sungafike pansi pake;
N'chachitali sungathe kuchikwera
Ee! Nchodabwitsa!

hymns.title: Pali chiyanjano ndi chimwemwenso
verses:
1. Pali chiyanjano ndi chimwemwenso
Potsamira pamkono wake.
Ndine wodala, mtendere ngwanga
Potsamira pa mkono wake.
hymns.chorus:
Potsamira, potsamira
Ndasinthika kuzoopsya;
Potsamira, potsamira
Potsamira pa mkono wake.

hymns.title: Mongatu Yesu, mongatu Yesu
verses:
1. Mongatu Yesu, mongatu Yesu,
Ndikhale monga Iye
Muulendo onse mpaka kumwamba
Ndikhale monga iye.

hymns.title: Dzulo, lero, nsiku zonse
verses:
1. Dzulo, lero, nsiku zonse
Yesu sasintha
Zinthu zonse zimasintha
Koma Yesu ayi.
Ulemelero kwa dzina lake
Zinthu zonse zimasintha
Koma Yesu ayi
Tiimbe ngati Yesu dzina lakukonda.

hymns.title: Tate wakumwambako likayera dzinalo
verses:
1. Tate wakumwambako likayera dzinalo
Chifuniro chanu'cho chichitike pansipa
Mutipatse lero e! chakudya chathuchi
Mutikhululukire monga tikhululukira
Mutipulumutse kumayeserowo
Wanu ndi ufumuwo mpaka nthawi zonsezo.

choruses.title: Ndi Yesu ali ndi chifundo nane
Kaya mufune kaya musafune Yesu akubwera
Ine toto kubwerera m'mbuyo ine toto
Ndifuna kufanana ndi Yesu moyo wanga
